title: ACT Test Day for Juniors Only
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
ACT TEST-JUNIORS ONLY
Just a reminder for THS families that on Wednesday, February 25th, 11th-grade students will be taking the ACT Test at the high school. On this day, ONLY 11th-grade students will report to school on the testing day. All other students (9th, 10th, and 12th grade) will not be reporting to school on this day. 11th graders will report by 7:50am to find their testing location. Most students will finish testing between 11:30am - 12:00pm and will need to be picked up at that time. Some students may take a little bit longer to finish. Please mark this down on your calendar.

title: Health Reminder for Flu Season
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
HEALTH AND WELLNESS
Health Reminder: Flu and Seasonal IllnessWe are seeing an increase in flu and seasonal illnesses at school. To help prevent the spread ofillness, please keep your child home if they have a fever (100°F or higher), vomiting or diarrhea,significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms.Students should be fever-free for 24 hours without medication and symptom-free for 24 hoursafter vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school. Thank you for helping keep our schoolcommunity healthy.

summary: **Flu and seasonal illnesses are increasing at school.** Please keep students home if they have a fever (100°F or higher), vomiting, diarrhea, significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms. Students must be **fever-free for 24 hours without medication** and **symptom-free for 24 hours** after vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school.

blocks.content: Sunday, January 11thMock Trial at UCMonday, January 12thDiversity Club 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 400Robotics 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 412Setting Stone 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 320Tribune 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 315Tuesday, January 13thArt Club 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 603Diversity Club 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 400Mock Trial 5:00 - 7:00 PM, room 315Robotics 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 412Wednesday, January 14thRobotics 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 412Thursday, January 15thChess Club 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 603Mock Trial 5:00 - 7:00 PM, room 315Project Green 2:30 - 3:30 PM, room 224 All are welcome!Friday, January 16thDrama 2:30 - 5:30 PM, PACSaturday, January 17thRobotics Competition in Lebanon - all members should register on the first website. See Ms. Schran with any questions.ON THE HORIZONTuesday, January 27th - Diversity Club will meet at Kofenya after schoolFriday, February 27th - 7:30 - 9:30 PM - Setting Stone Coffee House, THS Cafeteria

summary: Multiple clubs are meeting the week of January 11-17, with most sessions running **2:30-3:30 PM** in various rooms. **Mock Trial** meets at UC on Sunday, plus Tuesday and Thursday evenings (5:00-7:00 PM, room 315). **Robotics** has a competition in Lebanon on Saturday (registration required). Upcoming events include **Diversity Club at Kofenya** on January 27th and **Setting Stone Coffee House** on February 27th (7:30-9:30 PM, THS Cafeteria).

title: Senior Scholarship Booklets Available - Due 12/19
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education
summary: **Seniors:** Scholarship booklets for Talawanda High School Local Scholarships and The Oxford Community Foundation scholarships are now available. **Completed packets are due Thursday, December 19th by 3:00 PM.** Drop off all completed materials to Mrs. Sens in the Counseling Office.
